parties: Master Wovenlanka (Private) Limited v. Urban Council Katunayake-Seeduwa & Others Master Wovenlanka (Private) Limited v. Urban Council Katunayake-Seeduwa & Others View More
keywords: Local authority rates – Factory premises – Annual value increased from approximately Rs.315,570 to more than Rs.6.45 million – Revised assessment still nearly eighteen times previous valuation – Seizure notice – Statutory power to impose rates – New assessment requires direction/approval of competent Provincial Minister – Respondents failed to establish ministerial direction – Urban Council acted outside statutory powers – Impugned assessment and consequential enforcement held unlawful – Certiorari granted.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; Urban Councils Ordinance No. 61 of 1939 – sections 160(1), 160(3) and 166; Municipal Councils Ordinance – sections 233, 235, 236–243, particularly section 238; Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act No. 12 of 1989 – section 2(1); Ninth Schedule, List I of the Constitution.
